Chapter 17

Grandpa Wendell’s Catnip Mouse

“It’s for Pom-Pom. She deserves nice things.”

Read this aloud

Grandpa Wendell comes home from the pet shop with a paper bag, and through the paper you can smell it: catnip. A whole catnip mouse, red felt, with a string tail. His daughter June is in the kitchen putting the kettle on. In the front window, a large fluffy grey cat called Pom-Pom watches you all with deep contempt.

At a glance

House Standard · Patience 8 · The prize catnip mouse (Small) · Gone at the start of round 9 · Den Bathroom

Who lives here Grandpa Wendell, June, Pom-Pom, the robot vacuum

Three cats Patience 10, gone at the start of round 11, Lights Out at the end of round 13, 3 Cattitude each · Five cats Patience 7

Grandpa Wendell’s house has a hall, a front room where Pom-Pom rules, a kitchen with Pom-Pom’s microchip cat flap, a cellar under the kitchen with a cracked window, and upstairs a spare bedroom, a landing and the bathroom. The mouse is small — one cat can carry it — but it has to get out of the house, and Pom-Pom will want it too.

How it plays

  • Grab the mouse from the paper bag in the hall before Grandpa gives it to Pom-Pom at the start of round 4. After that you have to get past her.
  • Grandpa dozes. A sleeping Grandpa sees nothing — perfect for a quick snatch.
  • The robot vacuum tempts Hunters wherever it goes — and can be ridden.
  • Getting out is the hard part: plan the exit before you grab the mouse.

The Prize Clock

WhenThe prize
Start of round 1Grandpa Wendell puts it in the hall and stays there this round. Step 1: get it out of the bag (a Curious cat’s Knack) (Streetwise or Sneaky, Tricky).
Start of round 4Grandpa Wendell puts it in the living room and stays there this round. No roll to get at it.
Start of round 9Gone — unless the gang has got it out or a cat is holding it.
End of round 11Lights Out: any cat still inside is pinched.

Ways between rooms: Hall–Living room Big · Hall–Kitchen Big · Kitchen–Cellar Normal (door) · Hall–Landing Normal · Landing–Spare bedroom Big · Landing–Bathroom Big (the Den’s door: open, shut while a cat is in).

Pom-Pom’s cat flap only opens for her microchip; jam it (Streetwise, Tricky) and it stays open for everyone — but it rattles every time a cat goes through (a noisy entrance). The front door lets one cat in behind Grandpa in round 1. The cellar window is Tight: Lean cats only. The bedroom window is up the drainpipe: Hard.

The getaway

  1. The garden wall — Savage or Sneaky.
  2. The greenhouse — Sneaky or Streetwise, Tricky.
  3. The canal fence — Savage or Sneaky, Tricky.
  4. The footbridge — Savage or Sneaky.

Then the hideout. The loot is 1 piece.
